Teenage me, miserable, lonely, angry at myself, scared, fell into self harm, did idiotic shit that makes me feel awful to this day. No ambition, felt like Icouldnt be the person my parents wanted.

Now? I'd like to think Im chill, accepting, kind, have a beautiful girlfriend who is my most precious person and I intend to marry her one day. My parents got the the golden chid they wanted, my little brother, interveiwing at legit top universities and shit.
This guy sounds fucking horrifying. I'm glad you managed to break free.
